softwareValidation.note: Automated WebKit/iPhone evidence is not physical-device acceptance.

mediaRights.requiredToClose: At least one rights-cleared or Paradise-owned audio item and one rights-cleared or Paradise-owned video item must be loaded and then physically tested. Exact vendor recordings require an actual rights basis before internal re-hosting.

physicalDeviceAcceptance.requiredEvidence: Completed docs/PARADISE_UNIVERSITY_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE.md record on an actual iPhone for Safari and installed Home Screen PWA, including offline behavior and cleared audio/video playback.

humanCurriculumComplianceReview.requiredEvidence: Named human reviewer(s), date, exact candidate commit, and disposition covering curriculum accuracy, Paradise policy boundaries, field-authority separation, sales procedure holds, and media rights posture.

promotionAuthorization.requiredEvidence: Explicit authorization to advance the validated branch after all other gates are PASS.

validatedBranchReadback.requiredEvidence: After authorized promotion, read back validated branch commit, dataset SHA, 78/76/2 guards, and operational URL behavior before calling the release live.

hardRule: A green software validator is necessary but not sufficient for release. Do not change status to RELEASE_READY unless every required non-software gate is supported by recorded evidence.
